newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK/GREECE INTERVENES, SELLS 350MLN ECUS AT FIX.
newsitem.headline: BANK/GREECE INTERVENES, SELLS 350MLN ECUS AT FIX.

text.p: Bank of Greece, the central bank, sold 350 million ecus and 80 million marks for drachmas at Tuesday's fixing to stem the fall of the local currency, dealers said.
"The central bank sold 350 million ecus and 80 million marks at the fixing to contain the advance of the ecu and the mark against the drachma," a forex dealer at a foreign bank said.
Drachma settled at 311.90 at the fixing, down from Monday's 311.370 and mark/drachma was set at 160.100 against 159.870 on Monday.

Ecu/drachma opened at 311.45/50 today but early purchases of ecus for drachmas drove the cross higher to 311.75/85. Ecu sales for drachmas pushed it down to 311.60/65 around mid-session, dealers said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
